name: moving
description: Moving a home's things from one place to another, with or without packing.

appointmentWindowHours.description: How wide the arrival window is, in hours: the seller arrives within this many hours of the booked time.

packing.description: True when the seller also packs and unpacks.

howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow when the move is booked. Done is everything at the new place in one piece, and the buyer releases then. A timer to the seller, set past moving day, pays for a finished move if the buyer goes quiet; an arbiter both trust helps if something breaks on the way. Before paying, agree what happens to anything damaged.
